purpose: Canonical traceability extension for the zero-cost Vercel/Turso runtime, bounded storage policy, migration tooling and executable zero-cost policy validation.
rules: The monthly paid-compute budget remains zero and paid overage remains disabled.
Turso is the proposed canonical persistence target only after an explicitly approved production migration; Railway remains a read-only source until cutover evidence is complete.
Vercel automatic deployment is restricted to relevant main releases and non-main branch work must not create a live preview runtime.
Production cutover and Railway retirement remain HOLD until real source/destination and postdeploy evidence exists.

code_module_records.owner_object: Zero-cost Brain runtime persistence and bounded storage policy
code_module_records.schema: Turso/SQLite schema and provider-neutral persistence contracts with explicit storage-pressure thresholds
code_module_records.runtime_service: Vercel stateless API runtime backed by Turso free-tier persistence adapters
code_module_records.state_machine: request -> validate zero-cost runtime configuration -> read/write through Turso persistence -> enforce storage pressure -> return bounded runtime result or fail closed
acceptance_criteria: Turso persistence contracts preserve canonical Brain data semantics
storage pressure refuses noncanonical growth at the 85 percent threshold
deterministic PostgreSQL-to-SQLite migration and replay fixture verifies counts and hashes
production cutover remains gated until real migration and postdeploy evidence exists
code_module_records.source_preservation: preserved; Railway remains read-only migration source and no production source data is mutated or deleted by these modules
unresolved_gaps: live postdeploy Turso runtime proof remains HOLD
